import random
r = random.Random(92)
out = []
for _ in range(25):
    p = str(r.randint(1000, 10 ** 7)) + '.' + str(r.randint(0, 99)).zfill(2)
    rate = '%d.%03d' % (r.randint(0, 15), r.randint(0, 999))
    rows = sol.amortize(p, rate, r.choice([120, 180, 240, 360]))
    out.append((len(rows), rows[0], rows[-1], sum(int(x[1].replace('.', '')) for x in rows)))
result = out

import random
r = random.Random(93)
acc = []
for _ in range(30):
    p = str(r.randint(1, 10 ** 25)) + '.' + str(r.randint(0, 99)).zfill(2)
    rate = '%d.%06d' % (r.randint(0, 99), r.randint(0, 999999))
    rows = sol.amortize(p, rate, 1200)
    acc.append((len(rows), rows[0][0], rows[-1], sum(int(x[1].replace('.', '')) for x in rows) % 1000000007))
result = acc
